verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover enterprise-grade auth: SSO/SAML, domain capture, role-based permissions, compliance API, and managed policy settings via 'Claude for Enterprise', alongside API-key and Console-based auth for scalable programmatic access. This directly addresses compliance and scale concerns for engineering leads. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of SSO setup and no mention of specific cloud IAM integrations (e.g., AWS IAM, GCP Workload Identity) beyond general enterprise SSO claims.
